{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Related Work section positioning State Fidelity Validity (SFV) against five adjacent literatures — long-context degradation, cross-session memory benchmarks, computational reproducibility, prompt sensitivity, confabulation, and concept drift/provenance — and naming the gap as the unquestioned instrument stability assumption."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "concept-sfv",
      "name": "SFV",
      "aliases": ["State Fidelity Validity"],
      "description": "The framework the paper advances; positioned at an intersection no existing literature addresses directly, concerned with whether a pipeline's operative state stays faithful to its actual history.",
      "anchor": "SFV sits at an intersection",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-context-degradation-research",
      "name": "Context degradation research",
      "aliases": ["context degradation"],
      "description": "Work on within-session mechanics — whether the model can attend to information at position N as the context window fills.",
      "anchor": "Context degradation research asks",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-attention-dilution",
      "name": "Attention dilution",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Named alongside positional bias and retrieval accuracy degradation as an active area of long-context investigation.",
      "anchor": "Attention dilution",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-state-discontinuity",
      "name": "State Discontinuity",
      "aliases": ["T5"],
      "description": "The SFV threat (T5) that cross-session memory benchmarks document without validity-theoretic framing.",
      "anchor": "formalizes as State Discontinuity",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-mutable-instrument-problem",
      "name": "mutable instrument problem",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "The problem reproducibility frameworks do not address: a pipeline can be re-runnable yet not be the same instrument that produced the original results.",
      "anchor": "mutable instrument problem",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-prompt-sensitivity",
      "name": "prompt sensitivity",
      "aliases": ["Prompt sensitivity"],
      "description": "A cross-prompt phenomenon — how much a response varies with the prompt's surface form — held to be orthogonal to state degradation.",
      "anchor": "Research on prompt sensitivity",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-external-confabulation",
      "name": "External confabulation",
      "aliases": ["confabulation about external knowledge"],
      "description": "Confabulation about the world, which can be fact-checked against independent sources and is addressed by retrieval and grounding.",
      "anchor": "External confabulation",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-operational-confabulation",
      "name": "Operational confabulation",
      "aliases": ["SFV threat T2", "confabulation about operational history"],
      "description": "Confabulation about the pipeline's own operational history; not externally checkable because the pipeline is the only witness to its own decisions absent a canonical log, so it is addressed by provenance infrastructure.",
      "anchor": "Operational confabulation",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-concept-drift",
      "name": "Concept drift",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "The change in statistical properties of a target variable over time, studied in machine learning for decades; recent work documents analogous behavioral drift in deployed LLM services.",
      "anchor": "Concept drift",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-data-provenance-tracking",
      "name": "Data provenance tracking",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Maintaining traceable lineage for data transformations in scientific workflows; SFV extends this from data lineage to full pipeline state.",
      "anchor": "Data provenance tracking",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-agentic-memory-systems",
      "name": "Agentic memory systems",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Engineering mechanisms for maintaining state across context window boundaries and session restarts; they manage operational state without formalizing the validity question.",
      "anchor": "Agentic memory systems",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-state-fidelity",
      "name": "state fidelity",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "State fidelity as a measurement validity concern, distinguished from state persistence as an engineering capability.",
      "anchor": "state fidelity as a measurement",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    },
    {
      "id": "concept-instrument-stability-assumption",
      "name": "instrument stability assumption",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "The assumption underlying all four classical validity types, unquestioned because classical instruments do not change during measurement.",
      "anchor": "instrument stability assumption",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0003"
    }
  ],
